## License and provenance

Poly Haven states all site assets are CC0, permitting redistribution and commercial use without attribution. License source: https://polyhaven.com/license; captured copy: `LICENSE-source.html`. Creator names, source URLs, exact API responses, and publisher MD5s are preserved here. `SHA256SUMS` records all included bytes.

These are generic architectural/furniture assets, not evidence of historically accurate Yugoslav buildings or public-space design. Review façade style, geometry scale, collision/passability, mesh/material budgets, and RTS-camera readability before integration. Their appearance must not silently alter map navigation or gameplay acceptance.
